'''2006 Bespin Regional''' was a Star Wars CCG regional (April 2006). It is known from the decklists below, recovered from DeckTech posts and Players Committee forms.

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Original VS6]] (from the card pool legal on the event date)
* '''Site:''' —
* '''Dates:''' April 2006

== Worlds qualifiers ==

The Players Committee's list of qualifiers for the [[2006 World Championship|2006 World Championships]] names [[Tyler Vastag]] and [[Garrett Larson]] for the 2006 Bespin Regional, as Larson himself confirmed on 29 April 2006.<ref name="pcf-9443-130633">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=130633#130633 Qualifiers for Worlds 2006], Michael Carr (mc9457), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (3 April 2006). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20060618055549/http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=141112 Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="pcf-9443-134257">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=134257#134257 Qualifiers for Worlds 2006], Garrett Larson (deadbody), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (29 April 2006).
